headline: Popees Baby Care AGM: All resolutions passed
summary: Popees Baby Care India Ltd shareholders approved all four resolutions at the 38th AGM held on September 30, 2026, including auditor appointment and director re-election.

headline: Loans against FDs surge 43% to ₹2.04 lakh crore
summary: Loans against fixed deposits rose 43% to ₹2.04 lakh crore, with FCNR(B)-linked leverage cited as a key driver of the sharp increase in borrowing activity.

headline: Reliance Industries plans ₹1 lakh crore CBG investment
summary: Reliance Industries plans to invest ₹1 lakh crore in compressed biogas in Andhra Pradesh, with the initiative expected to create 3 lakh jobs in the state.

headline: Sikozy Realtors AGM: Borrowing limit set at ₹5 crore
summary: Sikozy Realtors shareholders approved a borrowing limit of ₹5 crore and adopted FY26 financials despite auditor's going concern warning.

headline: Drug panel rejects national cap on wholesale licences
summary: A drug panel has rejected the idea of a national cap on wholesale licences, instead calling for stricter monitoring at the state level to regulate drug distribution.

headline: Industries seek GST relief on input tax credit
summary: Pharma, EV, and other industries are seeking GST relief to unlock accumulated input tax credit, according to a newspaper report.

headline: SBI Research flags possible 25 bps repo rate hike
summary: SBI Research has flagged the possibility of the Reserve Bank of India raising the repo rate by 25 bps at the October Monetary Policy Committee meeting.

headline: MIAL plans to cut 265 weekly flight slots from Oct 26
summary: Mumbai International Airport plans to temporarily discontinue 265 weekly flight slots from October 26 as part of preparations for the redevelopment of Terminal 1.

headline: Indian coffee exports rise 25% to 2.42 lakh tonne in H1FY27
summary: India's coffee exports rose 25% to 2.42 lakh tonne in H1FY27, driven by strong global demand, benefiting exporters including CCL Products and Tata Consumer Products.

headline: Maharashtra FDA cancels Cipla unit's drug sale licence
summary: Maharashtra FDA has cancelled the drug sale licence of a Cipla unit over alleged violations, as reported by a newspaper. The development raises regulatory concerns for the pharma major.

headline: Jyothy Labs pauses acquisitions, eyes personal care
summary: Jyothy Laboratories has put acquisitions on hold and is shifting focus toward new product launches and the personal care segment, according to a newspaper report.

headline: 7Seas Entertainment AGM voting results submitted
summary: 7Seas Entertainment Ltd filed scrutinizer and e-voting results for its 35th AGM held on September 30, 2026. All ordinary resolutions passed with requisite majority.

headline: Bajaj Housing Finance Q2FY27 AUM up 25% to ₹1.58 lakh crore
summary: Bajaj Housing Finance reported 25% YoY growth in Assets Under Management to ₹1,58,190 crore in Q2FY27. Gross disbursements rose to ₹19,930 crore from ₹15,914 crore a year ago.

headline: Bajaj Finance Q2FY27: AUM up 26.5% to ₹5.84 lakh crore
summary: Bajaj Finance reported Q2FY27 operational metrics with AUM rising 26.5% YoY to ₹584,750 crore. Customer franchise expanded to 128.85 million, while new loans grew 11%.

headline: United Polyfab AGM passes all 9 resolutions
summary: United Polyfab Gujarat Ltd shareholders approved all nine resolutions at the AGM held on September 29, 2026. Key approvals included Gagan Mittal's appointment as CMD and material related party transactions.

headline: MOIL reports 19% YoY rise in Sept sales
summary: MOIL Limited recorded provisional manganese ore sales of 1.64 lakh MT in September 2026, up 15.5% YoY. Cumulative FY27 sales reached 7.78 lakh MT against a target of 25.85 lakh MT.

headline: Megamont approves all AGM resolutions
summary: Megamont Limited approved all three ordinary resolutions at its 36th AGM, including the adoption of FY26 financials and reappointment of director Minal Gaurav Patil.

headline: Viceroy Hotels lends ₹38.45 crore to subsidiary
summary: Viceroy Hotels Limited entered a loan agreement with wholly owned subsidiary SLN Terminus Hotels for ₹38.45 crore at 8.75% p.a. to repay borrowings.

headline: Rex Sealing AGM: Directors reappointed, financials adopted
summary: Rex Sealing & Packing Industries Ltd concluded its 21st AGM on September 30, 2026. Shareholders adopted FY26 financial statements and reappointed Mrs. Meeta Manjunath Nayak as director.

headline: Shreenath Paper takes 75% stake in subsidiary
summary: Shreenath Paper Products Limited has increased its stake in Shreenath Paper Industries Private Limited to 75%, making it a subsidiary effective September 24, 2026.

headline: RNIT AI appoints Patcha & Associates as internal auditors
summary: RNIT AI Solutions Limited appointed M/s. Patcha & Associates as internal auditors for FY27 following board approval on October 3, 2026.

headline: RBI Governor flags high cost of financial complacency
summary: RBI Governor stated no immediate financial sector risks are visible but cautioned that complacency carries a high economic cost, signalling the need for sustained vigilance.

headline: RBI Governor flags risks of prolonged financial stability
summary: RBI Governor cautioned that banking risks can develop quickly and that prolonged financial stability may reduce vigilance among institutions and regulators.

headline: Himalaya Nutravedics FY26 PAT jumps 231% to ₹739 lakh
summary: Himalaya Nutravedics India Limited reported a 231.1% surge in FY26 PAT to ₹739.0 lakh. Revenue doubled to ₹4,306.8 lakh as own-brand sales hit 51% of total revenue.

headline: Texmaco Rail wins ₹3.65 crore anti-bird disc order
summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹3.65 crore order from West Central Railway for an anti-bird disc project, with completion expected within one year.

headline: Neo Infracon CS Sonalben Kanabar resigns
summary: Neo Infracon Limited announced the resignation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Sonalben Kanabar. She will serve until October 31, 2026, citing personal reasons.

headline: RBI Governor: India leads global GDP growth
summary: RBI Governor stated that India has the strongest GDP growth globally, even amid the ongoing conflict in West Asia, highlighting the economy's resilience.

headline: Sedemac Q2FY27 ECU Sales Jump 37.5%
summary: Sedemac Mechatronics reports record quarterly sales of control-intensive ECUs, rising 37.5% YoY to 1.45 million units in Q2FY27.

headline: Garware Hi-Tech to host investor meet in Singapore
summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films will hold one-on-one meetings with institutional investors in Singapore from October 7-9, 2026, hosted by Motilal Oswal.

headline: DMart Q2FY27 revenue up 18% to ₹19,206 crore
summary: Avenue Supermarts reported standalone revenue of ₹19,206.18 crore for Q2FY27, marking an 18.4% YoY growth. The retailer expanded its network to 518 stores as of September 30, 2026.

headline: Bodal Chemicals adopts FY26 results at 40th AGM
summary: Bodal Chemicals shareholders adopted audited financial statements for FY26 and reappointed Ankit S. Patel as Executive Director. All resolutions passed with near-unanimous support.

headline: Sterling Greenwoods AGM results
summary: Sterling Greenwoods Limited filed voting results for its 34th AGM held on September 30, 2026. All five resolutions, including director appointments and financial statement adoption, passed with 100% support.

headline: Southern Petrochemical shuts plants for maintenance
summary: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation has shut down its plants for maintenance and equipment replacement, with operations expected to restart within four weeks.

headline: East West Freight approves new IT subsidiary
summary: East West Freight Carriers Ltd approved incorporating East West Advance Systems Private Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to enter the IT and deep-tech sector.

headline: Ceeta Industries director Bal Krishna Bhalotia passes away
summary: Ceeta Industries confirmed the sudden demise of Independent Director Bal Krishna Bhalotia on October 1, 2026. He served since August 2019.

headline: Uniworth AGM passes all resolutions unanimously
summary: Uniworth International Limited passed all three resolutions at its 33rd AGM held on September 30, 2026. The meeting approved financial statements and director appointments.

headline: WPIL Ltd to host investor meet with Kriis Portfolio
summary: WPIL Limited will hold a physical meeting with Kriis Portfolio in Kolkata on October 7, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed.

headline: Asian Fertilizers AGM: All Resolutions Passed Unanimously
summary: Asian Fertilizers Limited passed all seven resolutions at its 41st AGM held on September 30, 2026, with 100% votes in favor. Key approvals included director re-appointments and related party transactions.

headline: Batliboi board to consider preferential issue
summary: Batliboi Limited's board will meet on October 7, 2026, to approve the conversion of promoter loans and preference shares into equity via a preferential issue.

headline: MSP Steel & Power AGM voting results declared
summary: MSP Steel & Power Ltd announced the passing of all resolutions at its 57th AGM held on September 30, 2026. Key approvals included financial statements and managerial remuneration.

headline: Balgopal Commercial approves name change to Dreamax Enterprises
summary: Balgopal Commercial Limited shareholders unanimously approved the rebranding to Dreamax Enterprises Limited and authorized an increase in share capital during its 44th AGM.

headline: Zenith Steel AGM voting results
summary: Zenith Steel Pipes & Industries Ltd shareholders passed all six resolutions at its 64th AGM held on September 30, 2026, with over 99% votes in favor.

headline: Baazar Style Retail Q2FY27: Revenue falls 10% YoY
summary: Baazar Style Retail reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹4,781 million, down 10% YoY due to festive calendar shift. H1FY27 revenue grew 6% to ₹9,645 million as store count rose 13%.

headline: Diggi Multitrade AGM: All resolutions passed
summary: Diggi Multitrade Limited passed all three ordinary resolutions at its 16th AGM held via video conferencing. Voting results showed 100% support for financial adoption, auditor ratification, and director re-appointment.

headline: Maruti Global Industries closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Maruti Global Industries Limited has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after Q2FY27 results. This complies with SEBI insider trading regulations.

headline: Adon Agro Commodities holds 5th AGM
summary: Adon Agro Commodities Limited held its 5th Annual General Meeting on October 3, 2026. The meeting covered FY26 financials and director re-appointments.

headline: Hindustan Zinc posts record Q2 production
summary: Hindustan Zinc reported record refined metal production of 264 kt in Q2FY27, up 7% YoY. Silver output surged 20% to 173 tonnes, marking strong operational performance.

headline: Alfa Ica updates KMP contact details
summary: Alfa Ica (India) Ltd disclosed updated contact details for Key Managerial Personnel, including new Company Secretary Himadri Shah, per SEBI norms.

headline: Emmsons International AGM results: All resolutions passed
summary: Emmsons International Limited passed all three ordinary resolutions at its 33rd AGM held on September 30, 2026. Voting results show overwhelming support from promoters and public shareholders.

headline: Pankaj Polymers AGM approves FY26 financials
summary: Pankaj Polymers Ltd shareholders approved FY26 financials and re-appointed Rahul Nagar at the 34th AGM. All five resolutions passed with requisite majority.

headline: Citichem India AGM voting results declared
summary: Citichem India Limited submitted voting results for its 34th AGM held on September 30, 2026. All resolutions, including financial adoption and director reappointment, passed with requisite majority.

headline: Tejassvi Aaharam AGM results: 10 resolutions passed
summary: Tejassvi Aaharam Limited passed all 10 resolutions at its 32nd AGM held via video conference. Voting was conducted entirely through remote e-voting with no physical attendance.

headline: CMR Green CFO Yugal Kishor Garg resigns
summary: CMR Green Technologies announced the resignation of CFO Yugal Kishor Garg effective October 23, 2026. Satish Kumar Kaushik is proposed as successor.

headline: J&K Bank Q2FY27: Business up 19%, CASA dips
summary: J&K Bank reports provisional Q2FY27 metrics. Total business rose 19.38% YoY to ₹3,10,347 crore, but CASA ratio fell to 42.01%.

headline: IOB discloses ₹3,165 crore debt securities outstanding
summary: Indian Overseas Bank reported ₹3,165 crore in outstanding debt securities for H1FY27. The portfolio includes four instruments with coupons ranging from 7.80% to 9.08%.

headline: Unison Metals AGM results: All 5 resolutions passed
summary: Unison Metals Ltd announced voting results for its 36th AGM held on September 30, 2026. All five ordinary resolutions, including financial statement adoption and director re-appointment, were passed with requisite majorities.

headline: HMA Agro promoter seeks reclassification to public
summary: Wajid Ahmed requested reclassification from Promoter Group to Public category. He holds zero equity shares and claims no control over the company.

headline: Trident Texofab appoints new auditor, sets EGM date
summary: Trident Texofab Ltd appointed M/s. A Bafna & Associates as statutory auditor to fill casual vacancy and scheduled an EGM for October 28, 2026.

headline: ANS Industries AGM concludes with all resolutions passed
summary: ANS Industries held its 32nd AGM on September 30, 2026. Shareholders approved the adoption of FY26 financial statements and the re-appointment of director Dhruv Sharma.

headline: Bank of India Q2FY27 business grows 21%
summary: Bank of India reported 21.07% YoY growth in global business for Q2FY27, with deposits rising 21.60% and gross advances up 20.43%.

headline: SJ Corp CS resigns citing personal reasons
summary: Deepa Ashokkumar Dhamecha resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of SJ Corporation on October 2, 2026. The resignation is due to personal reasons and awaits board acceptance.

headline: Ganga Papers appoints Yash Mishra as CS
summary: Ganga Papers India Ltd appointed CS Yash Mishra as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 3, 2026, following the resignation of the previous officer.

headline: Addi Industries discloses AGM voting results
summary: Addi Industries Limited disclosed the e-voting results and scrutinizer's report for its 44th Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, in compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Hawa Engineers Q2FY27: Profit up 8% YoY
summary: Hawa Engineers reported a net profit of ₹57.02 lakh for Q2FY27, an 8.1% rise YoY. Revenue from operations declined 33.6% to ₹20.93 crore.

headline: Wipro completes merger of VLSI design unit
summary: Wipro Limited completed the merger of Wipro VLSI Design Services, LLC into Wipro IT Services, LLC effective October 1, 2026. The move aims to rationalize the group structure.

headline: Constronics Infra AGM voting results submitted
summary: Constronics Infra Ltd submitted voting results for its 34th AGM held on September 30, 2026. Both ordinary resolutions passed with over 99% support.

headline: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands seeks ESOP 2026 approval
summary: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited seeks member approval for its new ESOP Scheme 2026, covering up to 1.5% of paid-up capital, with e-voting open until November 2.

headline: Dev Labtech to meet on Oct 7 for capital raise
summary: Dev Labtech Venture Ltd board will decide on increasing authorized share capital and preferential allotment of equity shares or convertible securities.

headline: Nectar Lifesciences faces ₹89.32 crore CGST litigation
summary: Punjab and Haryana High Court remanded a CGST matter involving ₹89.32 crore demand back to the Appellate Authority for fresh consideration on September 24, 2026.

headline: Anand Seamless FY26 PAT jumps 107% to ₹548 lakh
summary: Anand Seamless Ltd reported a 106.7% surge in FY26 profit after tax to ₹547.8 lakh. Revenue from operations grew 66.9% to ₹5,600.4 lakh, driven by higher volume sales and improved capacity utilization.

headline: Tata Motors PV: JLR Q2FY27 wholesales up 25% YoY
summary: JLR reported Q2FY27 wholesale volumes of 82,400 units, a 25% YoY increase driven by UK and North America recovery. Retail volumes fell 7% YoY amid China challenges.

headline: Ujjivan SFB Q2FY27: Deposits up 29%, loans jump 32%
summary: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank reported strong Q2FY27 growth with deposits rising 29.2% YoY to ₹50,649 crore and gross loans up 32.1% to ₹45,699 crore, driven by MSME and housing segments.

headline: AMS Polymers appoints KVA & Co as auditors
summary: AMS Polymers Limited appointed M/s KVA & Company as Statutory Auditors for five years at its 41st AGM held on September 30, 2026.

headline: Vedanta Power Q2 sales up 26% YoY
summary: Vedanta Power Ltd reported a 26% YoY rise in Q2FY27 power sales to 5,593 million units. Meenakshi and Jharsuguda plants drove growth, offsetting Sakti's decline.

headline: Tusaldah plans ₹24.4 crore capital raise
summary: Tusaldah Limited to hold EGM on Oct 27, 2026, to approve authorized capital hike and preferential issue of shares and warrants worth over ₹24 crore.

headline: Gallard Steel AGM results: All resolutions passed unanimously
summary: Gallard Steel Ltd shareholders unanimously approved all six resolutions at the 11th AGM, including financial statements adoption and new director appointments.
